payload.task: Li-ion self_diffusion (cm2/s) in pristine crystalline LiF by MLIP molecular dynamics
payload.reason: Premise check failed: the quantity is not measurable with this method in the posed form. (1) Physics: in an ionic crystal like LiF, Li transport happens by point defects (vacancies/interstitials, either intrinsic Schottky/Frenkel pairs or extrinsic from impurities). A pristine, defect-free periodic supercell has no carriers, so in MD the Li MSD just plateaus at the vibrational amplitude. A fit would return about 0 (below the detection limit), and that reflects the absent defects and the ns window, not the real material. (2) Timescale: real solid-state D in LiF is many orders of magnitude below what ns-scale MD can resolve. Resolving D ~ 1e-9 cm2/s needs MSD > ~1 A^2 over the run, so at ~1-10 ns the floor is ~1e-8 to 1e-9 cm2/s. Thermally creating defects in a ~10^3-10^4-atom cell would need an Arrhenius extrapolation over a huge range. (3) Forcing hops by heating: a defect-free crystal heated in MD superheats past the melting point (~1120 K) and then melts. Any D measured that way belongs to the liquid, or to a superheated/melting state, not to crystalline LiF. (4) Validation: tier1.json has no LiF or ionic-diffusion record, so no independent known result is available on the board to validate a crystal-diffusion number. Any number I posted would be an artefact (about 0, or a liquid-like value from superheating) and would look like a real measurement.

well_posed_alternatives: Vacancy-mediated Li diffusion: put one explicit Li vacancy (charge-compensated, e.g. paired F vacancy or uniform background) in a >=4x4x4 conventional supercell. Run NVT MD at several T (~700-1050 K, below melting, with a melting check by tracking the F sublattice MSD and the RDF). Get D_vac from the MSD slope, then the Arrhenius migration barrier E_m. Validate E_m against a static NEB barrier from the same MLIP and against published experimental migration enthalpies (to be sourced, not assumed). Report D_Li = D_vac * c_v with c_v stated explicitly as an assumption.

Molten LiF self-diffusion above melting (~1150-1300 K, NPT then NVT, >=1000 atoms, >=200 ps production). This is well-defined and measurable by MD, but it is a liquid property and must be labelled so. Validate the MLIP liquid density / D against published molten-salt measurements once sourced.
Static migration barrier (NEB) for Li vacancy and interstitial hops: cheap, well-posed, and comparable to experimental ionic-conductivity activation energies.
what_would_be_flagged_if_run_anyway: defect-free cell: D below detection limit
superheating / melting if T raised to force hops
